sw_description: Hawk-bat chick of Coruscant's skylanes, small and fearless.
sw_datapad_text: A hawk-bat chick of Coruscant. It is small but fearless and will take on much bigger foes. It nests under the city's sky bridges.

sw_description: Hawk-bat that dives between Coruscant's towers to hunt.
sw_datapad_text: A hawk-bat of Coruscant. It dives between the towers at high speed to snatch prey. It keeps its wings glossy and flies high on clear days.

sw_description: Shyyyo chick that glides on the sea winds of Kashyyyk.
sw_datapad_text: A shyyyo chick of Kashyyyk. It rides the sea winds with its long wings stretched out. It nests on the cliffs along the coast.

sw_description: Huge shyyyo bird that carries riders and cargo over Kashyyyk.
sw_datapad_text: A great shyyyo bird of Kashyyyk. It skims the sea and carries prey in its huge bill. Wookiees say it once carried a lost Jedi to safety.

sw_description: Small, shy bogling with a lily pad on its back.
sw_datapad_text: A small bogling of Bogano. The lily pad on its back has grown too heavy for it to stay on land. It drifts on ponds and pools.

sw_description: Oggdo tadpole that wanders the Bogano shores on cold mornings.
sw_datapad_text: An oggdo tadpole of Bogano. On cold mornings it leaves the water and wanders the shore. It is coated in slime that keeps it from drying out.

sw_description: Huge frog-like oggdo that waits with its mouth open.
sw_datapad_text: An oggdo, the giant frog of Bogano's marshes. It never thinks too hard. It sits with its mouth open and lets prey swim right in.

sw_description: Dark rawka crow of Dathomir; seeing one is a bad omen.
sw_datapad_text: A rawka of Dathomir. Seeing one at night is said to bring bad luck. It flocks around the Nightsisters' old ruins and hoards shiny things.

sw_description: Fleet ikopi antelope of Naboo's plains with mesmerizing horns.
sw_datapad_text: An ikopi of Naboo's grass plains. Its curved horns make the air shimmer. Staring at them makes the mind go blank.

sw_description: Puffer pig that bounces on its tail and sniffs out gems.
sw_datapad_text: A puffer pig that bounces on its spring-like tail. Its heart beats with every bounce. It sniffs out gems and ore in the tunnels.

sw_description: Grown puffer pig that channels the Force through the gems it wears.
sw_datapad_text: A grown puffer pig. It wears the gems it found on its head. It puffs up and dances to bend the will of its foes.

sw_description: Thala-siren pup of Ahch-To that loves icy water.
sw_datapad_text: A thala-siren pup of Ahch-To. It loves to swim in freezing water. A horn on its head breaks through the ice.

sw_description: Sleek thala-siren that lounges on Ahch-To's rocks.
sw_datapad_text: A thala-siren of Ahch-To. It lounges on the rocks and swims gracefully in icy seas. Its green milk is said to be very good for you.

sw_description: Mogu cub that slams into wroshyr trees to toughen up.
sw_datapad_text: A mogu cub of Kashyyyk. It loves to wrestle and builds its strength by slamming into wroshyr trees.

sw_description: Massive mogu whose palm strikes fell trees.
sw_datapad_text: A massive mogu of Kashyyyk. Its palm strikes can fell a tree. It roars and beats the ground before every fight.
